entities.summary: Xavier Misael Castañeda, sometimes spelled Castaneda, is an American-born naturalized Bosnian professional basketball player for MoraBanc Andorra of the Spanish Liga ACB on loan from Unicaja. Standing 1.84 meters tall, he plays as a point guard and shooting guard.
